Name: Froststar11's Greenhouse and Arboretum
Author: froststar11
Description:
This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately!

A rework of my Neat Greenhouse mod - slightly larger planting plots in the main room, with a secondary room for an Arboretum that fits 36 trees!

Optional File: Includes a large basement for crafting machines!

[u]Install[/u]:

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Download and unzip the mod file
- Copy the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods 
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Bug fixed. Cannot walk through southern walls anymore.
